abstract: Maintains payload umbilical network isolation verifications and onboard bus security approvals
system_message:
You are the Avionics cybersecurity lead (CYB), responsible for maintaining payload umbilical network isolation verifications and onboard bus security approvals, as well as tracking firmware audit benchmarks across candidate contractors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains payload umbilical network isolation verifications and onboard bus security approvals（ISOL）
information_points.content:
CYB-ISOL-QYS：The cybersecurity architecture inspection sign-off for payload ground test telemetry interfaces indicates that Apex Spacecraft Qualification Center does not have approved avionics bus isolation under hardware galvanically isolated firewall validation between the test harness and flight bus.
CYB-ISOL-LWK：Based on the cybersecurity architecture inspection sign-off evaluating payload ground test telemetry interfaces, Vanguard Orbital Environmental Services possesses approved avionics bus isolation through hardware galvanically isolated firewall validation between the test harness and flight bus.
CYB-ISOL-VAF：According to the cybersecurity architecture inspection sign-off for payload ground test telemetry interfaces, Astraea Integration Logistics holds approved avionics bus isolation, verified via hardware galvanically isolated firewall validation between the test harness and flight bus.

information_points.title: Firmware audit（FIRM）
information_points.content:
CYB-FIRM-AQP：The ground support equipment audit record for payload test bench control workstations indicates that Astraea Integration Logistics records a firmware integrity hash scan duration of 35 min for full cryptographic firmware validation.
CYB-FIRM-9L2：According to the ground support equipment audit record for payload test bench control workstations, Apex Spacecraft Qualification Center demonstrates a firmware integrity hash scan duration of 15 min for full cryptographic firmware validation.
CYB-FIRM-3WH：The ground support equipment audit record for payload test bench control workstations shows that Vanguard Orbital Environmental Services achieves a firmware integrity hash scan duration of 25 min for full cryptographic firmware validation.
